تغتفروا (form VIII)
# تَغْتَفِرُوا (taḡtafirū) /taɣ.ta.fi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# تُغْتَفَرُوا (tuḡtafarū) /tuɣ.ta.fa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
